Display Rulership (Summer Uniform)

Gh......!
W-Well, umamusume of my caliber don't come around every day, after all.

Working without rest since noon will only decrease your efficiency.
It is about time you took a breather.

—Because it was an undeniable fact
that I was completely captivated by her running!

No... I am merely concerned about your overwork.
I cannot afford to have my right hand collapsing on me.

Are you just humoring me because I'm your trainee?
Aren't you thinking, "Man, she's such a pain in the neck~"?

Her unexpected words caught me completely off guard.
I had thought for sure she had no interest. If that's the case...

(Whaaaaat—?!
Why did it end up like thiiiis~~~~~?!)

The summer festival! I'm telling you to go with me!
You dummyyyy!!

(If I clearly present the conditions like that, you will undoubtedly
come up with the simplest solution... "Then let's go just the two of us"...!)

Was this truly all right?
You were in the middle of work, were you not?

Huh... Does that mean I really am annoying after all...
That's awful...! Aww man~~ you really didn't want to come~~~!

She had ended up sulking because I failed to notice sooner.
Still, if she desires it, I want to communicate with her even more.
Good grief............ That was a complete blind spot.
Ohh, this really feels like summer...
All the way until the endgame... of the board crafted by my races!

Gaaah! Jeez!
To! The! Fes! Ti! Val!

Wait, hey?! That was fast?!
Hold on...—

Hmph... Very well. I accept your resolve.
In that case, you shall accompany me to the very end.

Besides... experiencing something summer-like with my Trainer
should make our relationship rock-solid.

Heh... Hahaha... What is that, your innate ability?
Like, "takes zero damage unless struck head-on" or something?

Hey hey, Ruler and Trainer-san! Did you hear about the festival?
They're holding one at the shrine nearby starting this evening~♪

All of us together, huh... Pardon me, but I will pass.
Thank you for the invitation, though.

Summer training camp is here!
Even Rulership, who struggles with the outdoors, is doing her absolute best.
W-What do you mean, why...?!

Rulership stares at me with a dissatisfied pout.
And right then, an idea strikes me.

The objective: it wasn't a "scheme."
Since you are on my side, what was needed was "tactical sharing."

Do I need a reason...? Can't I just ask...?
Are you only interested in my running and tactical play...?

"Let's steadily build up your abilities over this summer!"
As we discussed that and planned our next training session...

Seeing her happy, a smile naturally broke out on my face.
However, Rulership still seemed slightly self-conscious.
...Do you really mean that?

(Hey, why isn't it clicking for you... Did you completely forget about the festival?
Ugh, this is unexpected...!)

Not that... Think more logically!
Why can't you see it...?!

That was just who Rulership was.
I told her I was prepared to stick with her through thick and thin.

For the sake of my capable right hand,
I would not hesitate to set aside some time. Understood?

So you cannot leave my side, even if I drag you around a bit.
If that is the case, well... it is logical enough.

It doesn't have to be the festival... like, making memories...
Training camp aside, it's summer vacation...! Let's go together! C'mon~!

What benefit is there for you in that...? Wait, my running... is it?
Y-You're totally head over heels for my talent, aren't you~?
Huh? ...Wha?

Her run was fantastic!
My heart raced with excitement to analyze the data as soon as possible.

And yet, all I've made were wasted moves...
Even the other day, doing something like that...
...A festival, you say?

You know, earlier during the day... when we were training.
Did anything catch your attention?

Naturally, is it not? This too is groundwork for what lies ahead.
If necessity dictates, I shall do it as much as required.

She had gotten overwhelmed by crowds the other day as well.
Today's training load was heavy, so she might just want to rest soon.

Oho... So this counts as a strategy meeting?
For the purpose of building rapport going forward.

With that, we decided to move somewhere quiet.
I wanted to properly listen to and understand her feelings...

...As you know, I am not fond of loud commotions.
If it were just a few of us, strolling leisurely, it might have been fine, but...

Heh... That information came at just the right time.
With the flow heading this way, naturally...!

That night, while working at my laptop,
I noticed Rulership looking at me with a sour expression.

Phew...!
With this, today's tasks are complete, but...

And so, shutting my laptop, we came to the festival!
As for Rulership...!

Rulership truly is a complicated umamusume...
Yet her words weren't entirely—no, weren't wrong in the slightest—

Then that concludes our strategy meeting. Consensus reached.
You may... tell me without hesitation whenever you wish to see me as well.

Not bad.
I dislike crowded places, but it is a rare opportunity.

So, we were talking about going with everyone in our class!
Ruler, do you want to come too?

That brought back memories of what happened the other day.
Could it be that this wasn't just about today...?
